bugs_found: compound_interest negates annual_rate, rejecting valid positive rates and accepting negative rates as positive growth
compound_interest silently truncates years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing inputs like 1.9 years or 12.9 compounds without validation
transfer does not coerce/validate amount as Decimal, so float or hostile numeric types can cause TypeError or inconsistent arithmetic after earlier checks
transfer is not atomic: if balance debit succeeds but credit assignment fails due to malformed account_to.balance or custom object behavior, funds can be debited without corresponding credit
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount, effectively charging more than the transaction amount without validation
fx_convert does not validate rate positivity or finiteness, so zero/negative/NaN/Infinity rates can produce invalid converted amounts
financial outputs are not quantized to currency precision, allowing sub-cent balances and silent precision policy drift
